addendum_content_raw:
Regarding Part VII:
Lines 3-10 reflect fund categories for a deferred compensation account.  The account is a 457 plan.  It is managed by the State of Oregon Savings Growth Plan. 
 Each item listed reflects investment categories as opposed to mutual funds.  I can select the categories, however, I have no control over the individual investments
 within the categories.  The Oregon Savings Growth Plan controls the make-up of the categories.  The plan does not generate any dividends or other income.  The
 value of the plan depends entirely on market fluctuations.
Line 14 is Trust 1. The reported values correspond to the total value of Trust 1. My share would be 1/7 of the total value.
Line 16 is a non-interest bearing checking account.
